recipe.visualDefinition: A side-profile candid of a male musician with voluminous feathered hair playing a white electric guitar under dramatic stage lights. The scene is characterized by deep blue shadows, warm highlights, and a cigarette in the mouth, framed by a high-contrast graphic layout in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject profile facing right against a dark, out-of-focus stage background
Bright white guitar body acting as a visual anchor in the lower center
Contrast between cool blue rim lighting and warm facial highlights
Graphic text block floating in the upper right quadrant with horizontal underlining
coreInvariants: White electric guitar with visible fretboard and strings
Cigarette held in mouth at a slight upward angle
Dual-tone typographic treatment (script over condensed sans-serif)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician occupies the left two-thirds of the frame in a medium shot, angled toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white body of the electric guitar provides the highest value point in the lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright guitar, follows the arm up to the face and cigarette, then moves to the graphic text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black and dark blue stage environment on the left and far right provides breathing room for the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and cobalt blue provide the atmospheric shadow tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white from the shirt and guitar body creates high-value focal points.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red and neon pink used for the script typography and underlining.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark backgrounds and blown-out highlights on the subject's skin and clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of a loose, expressive script and an ultra-condensed, high-contrast sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script text features thick-to-thin pressure variation with a sharp, italicized lean.
Sans-serif text is extremely tall (high aspect ratio) with thin vertical strokes and thick horizontal terminals.
Letters in the sans-serif block are tightly tracked with minimal kerning.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'E' has a large, sweeping top loop.
The sans-serif 'A' and 'M' have sharp, pointed apexes.

composition.relationshipToImage: anchored by a red horizontal bar below

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive organic script layered over rigid, geometric architectural type.

preserve: The vertical elongation of the secondary text
The neon red color of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s hand-drawn energy of the top line.
Provides the necessary vertical stretch and high contrast for the bottom line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic photograph of a male rock star with 80s feathered hair, side profile, playing a white electric guitar. Lighting is dramatic stage lighting with blue rim lights and warm spotlights. Dark stage background with blurred equipment. Include a cigarette in the subject's mouth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-layer text block in the upper right. Top layer: a neon red expressive script font angled slightly. Bottom layer: an ultra-condensed, tall blue sans-serif font in all caps. Place a thick red horizontal line directly beneath the bottom text.

verificationChecks: Is the hair voluminous and backlit?
Is the guitar body bright white?
Is the typography in the top right corner using the red/blue/white palette?
Is the cigarette clearly visible in the profile?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue stage lighting
Degree of vertical stretch on the condensed font
Amount of lens flare on the stage lights
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Specific brand names on guitar headstock

mustAchieve: Authentic 1980s film grain and color grading
High-contrast lighting typical of live performance photography
Clean, sharp graphic overlay that contrasts with the soft photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text overlaps the condensed text slightly.
Check that the guitar strings are visible against the white body.
Verify the red underline is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the blue lighting creates a 'halo' effect on the hair.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stage Portrait + Dual-Tone Retro Typography + High Contrast Blue/White Palette
